questions.q: What put a break on the Muslim conquests for around a decade?
options: Internecine fighting after the murder of the third Caliph
Twenty years of conquests came to a halt.
questions.rationale: With the murder of the third Caliph, internecine fighting broke out among Muslims, which put a break to this series of conquests for around a decade.

questions.q: What did God teach Adam, according to the passage quoted?
options: He then set them before the angels.
questions.rationale: He taught Adam all the names and then set them before the angels.

questions.article: War as an Instrument to Acquire Power
questions.q: What is the verse “Fight them until there is no more persecution” aimed at ending?
options: The same point is made as a negation and as an affirmation.
questions.rationale: The verse indicates that persecution or fitna should be put an end to.

questions.q: What phenomenon appears in the later periods of any religious community?
options: Its religion is divided into factions or sects
‘each one exulting in what they have.’
questions.rationale: A phenomenon inevitably appears — that of its religion being divided up into different factions or sects.

questions.q: What does the article say of three major initiatives to create a good society?
options: The article says they were tried and failed.
No consensus exists on what a good society is.
questions.rationale: Three major initiatives, designed in their separate ways to offer a solution, have been utter failures.

questions.article: The Concept of State in Islam
questions.q: Who is the actual possessor of power, according to the verse quoted?
options: He gives power to whom He pleases and takes it away.
questions.rationale: The actual possessor of power is God, and it is He who grants power on earth to whom He wills.

questions.q: How does the article define belief in God?
options: To look up to Him alone
Disbelief is to venerate others besides Him.
Awe of nature is given as an ancient form of disbelief.
questions.rationale: To believe in God is to look up to Him alone, while disbelief is to live in veneration of others besides Him.

questions.q: How do the true servants of the Gracious One respond when addressed by the ignorant?
options: They walk upon the earth with humility.
questions.rationale: When they are addressed by the ignorant ones, their response is, ‘Peace’.
